name: 头部姿态估计分析
description: 检测3D头部姿态轨迹中的不一致性，表明面部操纵。
useCase: Exposing deepfakes through unnatural head pose transitions and geometric inconsistencies
mechanism: Estimates 3D head orientation (pitch, yaw, roll) across frames and analyzes the trajectory smoothness. Deepfake face swaps often produce head poses that are inconsistent between the source and target face, creating detectable discontinuities in the pose trajectory.
source: Yang, X. et al. (2019) - Exposing Deep Fakes Using Inconsistent Head Poses, ICASSP
algorithm: 3D Head Pose Estimation (PnP) + Trajectory Smoothness Analysis + Source-Target Consistency
parameters: Landmarks: 68-point model, Pose estimation: EPnP algorithm, Smoothness: Savitzky-Golay filter
